purpose: Audit of every scientific figure-source and paper-table artifact for value provenance, primary/secondary separation, cross-metric ranking, correct n, and visibility of negative/fragile results.

figure_source_checks.ptt_fragility_visible: yes - figure_C explicitly includes s2_with_without and leave_one_subject_out, with claim_boundary requiring individual subject points (no mean+CI bar)
figure_source_checks.n3_regression_visible: yes - figure_G includes n3_false_positive_breakdown and an explicit claim_boundary stating N3 regresses and must not be omitted
figure_source_checks.interaction_unresolved_visible: yes - figure_I's claim_boundary explicitly forbids captioning as 'no interaction' or 'synergy found'
figure_source_checks.seed_vs_population_variability_labeled: yes in every figure's uncertainty_meaning field

paper_table_checks.table2_verified_note: header is [experiment_id, metric, baseline_value, candidate_value, effect, effect_direction, evidence_strength] - each row keeps its own metric label, no combined rank/score column
paper_table_checks.values_traced_to_canonical_source: yes - every table built by ml/build_paper_science_tables.py directly from results/*.json, no hand-typed duplicate constants found on inspection
